title.zh: 将布拉干省圣伊尔德丰索市镇的布拉干国立农业州立学院（BNASC）更名为布拉干农业州立学院（BASC）的法案
title.en: AN act renaming the Bulacan National Agricultural State College (BNASC) in the Municipality of San Ildefenso, Province of Bulacan, as the BULACAN AGRICULTURAL STATE COLLEGE (BASC)
title.orig: AN act renaming the Bulacan National Agricultural State College (BNASC) in the Municipality of San Ildefenso, Province of Bulacan, as the BULACAN AGRICULTURAL STATE COLLEGE (BASC)
title.vi: Đạo luật đổi tên Cao đẳng Bang Nông nghiệp Bulacan Quốc gia tại Đô thị San Ildefenso, Tỉnh Bulacan thành Cao đẳng Bang Nông nghiệp BULACAN
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติเปลี่ยนชื่อวิทยาลัยของรัฐเกษตรกรรม Bulacan แห่งชาติในเทศบาล San Ildefenso จังหวัด Bulacan เป็นวิทยาลัยของรัฐเกษตรกรรม BULACAN
title.id: Undang-Undang Mengubah Nama Sekolah Tinggi Negeri Pertanian Bulacan Nasional di Kotamadya San Ildefenso, Provinsi Bulacan menjadi Sekolah Tinggi Negeri Pertanian BULACAN
title.ms: Akta Menukar Nama Kolej Negeri Pertanian Bulacan Kebangsaan di Perbandaran San Ildefenso, Wilayah Bulacan kepada Kolej Negeri Pertanian BULACAN

text.en: The Bulacan National Agricultural State College (BNASC) in the Municipality of San Ildenfonso, Province of Bulacan, is hereby renamed as the Bulacan Agricultural State College (BASC)
All laws or decrees inconsistent with the provision of this Act are hereby deemed amended accordingly.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
